status: retrospective snapshot - shipped and verified, not a proposal. See profile.md's status banner. python/src/jayasree/_chars.py is the actual source of truth; this file may drift from it over time and should not be treated as authoritative if it does.

independent_vowels.note: 13 standard letters, standalone at word start. INDEPENDENT_VOWELS in _chars.py.

rare_vowels.note: RARE_VOWELS in _chars.py. Sanskrit-loanword-only: ൠ long vocalic R, ഌ vocalic L, ൡ long vocalic L. Shipped and recorded, not excluded.

consonants.note: REGULAR_CONSONANTS in _chars.py - 33 basic consonants, Sanskrit-derived inventory.

special_consonants.note: SPECIAL_CONSONANTS in _chars.py - 3 Dravidian consonants with no Sanskrit equivalent (retroflex la, zha, alveolar ra). CONSONANTS = REGULAR_CONSONANTS + SPECIAL_CONSONANTS (36 total).

rare_consonants.note: RARE_CONSONANTS in _chars.py - ഩ (alveolar na, U+0D29), ഺ (alveolar ta, U+0D3A). Traditional-text tier, included for completeness; NOT part of the 36-member CONSONANTS tuple - add explicitly where needed.

chillu.note: CHILLU in _chars.py - 6 bare word-final consonant forms (no inherent vowel). Each has a legacy 3-codepoint spelling (consonant+virama+ZWJ) that is visually identical and normalized to this atomic codepoint at runtime before any lookup - see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's 'Chillu letters' section for the full mechanism, not restated here.

matras.note: MATRAS in _chars.py - 12 dependent vowel signs. ൊ/ോ/ൌ are compound/split signs with a canonical NFD decomposition into a prefix+suffix pair (ൊ→െ+ാ, ോ→േ+ാ, ൌ→െ+ൗ); ൈ is the one exception with no decomposition (single prefix-only glyph in Manjari). See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's 'Compound vowel signs' section for the composition mechanism - stated here only as the linguistic fact of which signs split and how.

au_length_mark.note: AU_LENGTH_MARK in _chars.py (U+0D57) - a separate codepoint from the au vowel sign ൌ (U+0D4C) in matras above; used standalone or as ൌ's own suffix component after decomposition. Distinct role, don't conflate the two.

rare_matras.note: RARE_MATRAS in _chars.py - vocalic RR (U+0D44), vocalic L (U+0D62), vocalic LL (U+0D63) signs. Sanskrit-loanword tier, shipped and recorded.

virama.note: VIRAMA in _chars.py (chandrakkala, U+0D4D) - suppresses the inherent vowel; also the trigger for chillu's legacy spelling and every subjoined conjunct tail.

numerals.note: NUMERALS in _chars.py - 10 Malayalam digits. As with Hindi's Devanagari digits, Latin digits are also common in modern Malayalam text but are UNIVERSAL_CHARS-shaped (script-independent), not part of this category.

subjoined_conjunct_tails.note: Not a category in _chars.py itself (these are 2-codepoint sequences: consonant-independent virama+ya/va/la/ra, not standalone characters) - listed here because they are composable marks in glyph-data.json's marks table (23 entries total, alongside every matra + virama + anusvara + visarga + au-length-mark + 3 rare matras) with their own {shift, prefix, suffix, trailingWidth} recipe, the closest Devanagari-half-form analogue this project has. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's 'The mark recipe' section for the mechanism.

true_ligatures.note: Not enumerated as a flat list here (~108 conjunct clusters, font- and shaping-dependent - see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's Stage-1 section and README's Status section for the figure's provenance). These are consonant+consonant (and consonant-chain) conjuncts that fuse into a single Manjari glyph unrelated to their parts' own shapes, verified by real HarfBuzz shaping during build_glyph_data.py's run, not hypothesized - the equivalent of Hindi's still-open 'akhand ligature' question, already closed here since Malayalam is shipped.
